# Test Plan
Defines the odsens.com test harness (Vitest `unit`/`db`, Playwright `smoke`/`e2e` + axe, fixtures, seed, CI) and enumerates every test the v1 slices must land, by ID, so gate agents can check "the tests the slice requires exist" as a yes/no.
Status: **v1.0 — FROZEN 2026-08-17** (changes only via ADR + doc edit in the same PR; `spec-drift-reviewer` enforces) — amended by ADR-0007 (2026-08-20) — amended by ADR-0010, ADR-0012, ADR-0013 (2026-08-20) — amended by ADR-0014 (2026-08-20) — amended by ADR-0015 (2026-08-20) — amended by ADR-0017 (2026-08-21) — amended by ADR-0019 (2026-08-21)

Sources this doc is bound to (it re-decides nothing they settle): `docs/build/06-decisions/ADR-0002-spec-reconciliation.md` (binding for every contradiction C1–C22 and OPEN default 13–80 cited below), `docs/build/_registry.md` (IDs/names), `docs/data-model.md` §4 (RLS matrix) and §5 (sync), `docs/notifications.md`, `docs/spec.md`, `docs/questions.md` (Q34/35/38/39/40), `DESIGN.md` §5/§6/§9/§11/§12, `.claude/skills/test-engineer/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/backend-robustness/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/security-check/SKILL.md`, `.claude/agents/*.md`. Sibling contracts: 01 (invariants), 02 (routes/pages), 03 (components), 04 (server contracts). Where a shape (input schema, error code, rate-limit number, storage path, adapter function name) is 04's to define, this doc uses 04's current value (v0.3, as amended by ADR-0002) verbatim and tests the *behaviour* named here; where 02 owns page behaviour (redirect codes, sort enums, smoke list) this doc uses 02's current value (v0.3, as amended by ADR-0002).

How to read: every `T-<layer>-<n>` is one test case (or, for T-RLS, one row that expands to one case per role column). Every rule `H-n`, `F-n`, `SEED-n`, `CI-n`, `FLK-n`, `COV-n` is checkable with a path/name/number. §8 maps slices → required test IDs; §9 maps gates → what they run. **ID ownership (H-13):** this doc owns every `T-*` number; 04 §8 and the per-contract "Tests (05)" rows cite these numbers verbatim; 00 and 01 cite them by number or by the layer names below.

## 1. Harness

### 1.1 Tooling (fixed)
| Layer | Tool | Config file | Package script | Runs where |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unit | Vitest, project `unit` | `vitest.config.ts` (`test.projects[0].name = "unit"`) | `pnpm test:unit` | anywhere; no network, no DB |
| DB / integration | Vitest, project `db` | `vitest.config.ts` (`test.projects[1].name = "db"`) | `pnpm test:db` | against `supabase start` (local stack, `supabase/config.toml`, API `:54321`, DB `:54322`) |
| Both | — | — | `pnpm test` = `test:unit` + `test:db` | local + CI |
| E2E / smoke / axe | Playwright + `@axe-core/playwright` | `playwright.config.ts` | `pnpm test:e2e` (all) · `pnpm test:e2e --project=smoke-desktop --project=smoke-phone` (smoke only) | against `pnpm build && pnpm start` on `http://localhost:3000` + local Supabase |
| Contrast | `scripts/contrast.mjs` | — | `pnpm contrast` | anywhere (pure) |
| Email render | React Email | `emails/` | `pnpm email dev` (preview, not a test); render tests live in `unit` | — |

**Harness note (2026-08-20, ADR-0014 — no rule change):** `playwright.config.ts` is owned by `test-engineer`. Its `webServer.env` is every name in the committed `.env.test` as defaults, the shell's values on top (shell wins, as in CI where the workflow sources `.env.test` first), plus `E2E=1` always (enables `/__test/throw`, T-E2E-15). A plain `pnpm build` against `.env` is not a valid e2e build: `set -a; source .env.test; set +a; pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e`.

**Layers (registry `T-<layer>-<n>`, layers RLS/ACT/ADP/E2E/UNIT only — no `T-DB`, no `T-JOB`):** T-RLS = policies/triggers/RPC grants (`db`); **T-ACT = Server Actions, route handlers *and* jobs (`lib/jobs/*`) incl. `notifyFanOut`/`notifyDeliver`** (`db`, adapters' `fetch` mocked to fixtures); T-ADP = adapters (`unit`); T-UNIT = pure helpers/scripts/emails (`unit`); T-E2E = Playwright. Layer aliases used by siblings map here: 00's "(T-UNIT)" on job/notify acceptance criteria and 01 INV-24's "`T-ADP-*`/`T-DB-*` run twice" = **T-ACT-45…56, 70…75** (00/01 amended to this mapping by the ADR-0002 PR).

### 1.2 Directory layout (from `_registry.md` repo layout)
| Path | Contains |
|---|---|
| `tests/unit/**/*.test.ts` | T-UNIT, T-ADP (adapters are pure functions over injected `fetch` + fixtures) |
| `tests/db/**/*.test.ts` | T-RLS (`tests/db/rls/<table>.test.ts`, one file per table/view/bucket/RPC group), T-ACT (`tests/db/actions/<action>.test.ts`, `tests/db/routes/<handler>.test.ts`, `tests/db/jobs/<job>.test.ts`) |
| `tests/e2e/**/*.spec.ts` | T-E2E; `tests/e2e/smoke/*.spec.ts` (projects `smoke-desktop`, `smoke-phone`), `tests/e2e/flows/*.spec.ts` (project `e2e`), `tests/e2e/admin/*.spec.ts` (project `admin`, serial) |
| `tests/fixtures/` | recorded upstream JSON/XML/HTML per 01 INV-06 `<source>` dirs `modrinth/`, `curseforge/`, `youtube/`, `oembed/`, `resend/`, `discord/`, `kofi/` (P2); binary fixtures `files/`, `images/`; `emails/__snapshots__/`, `{discord,resend}/__snapshots__/`; `ui/*.ts` (03 O-1 component fixture data) — the `<source>` dirs come from 01 INV-06; `_registry.md` Repo layout names the non-source dirs (`tests/fixtures/{files,images,ui,emails,discord,resend}`) |
| `tests/helpers/` | `asRole.ts`, `expectPolicy.ts`, `callAction.ts`, `spies.ts`, `factories.ts`, `fixtures.ts`, `storage.ts`, `loginAs.ts`, `axe.ts`, `screenshots.ts`, `mockFetch.ts`, `time.ts`, `seedIds.ts`, `fixtureServer.ts` |
| `test-results/` | Playwright output; `test-results/screenshots/<route-slug>@<width>.png` (gitignored, uploaded as CI artifact) |
| `.env.test` | committed; local Supabase URL + the CLI's local anon/service keys (non-secret) for `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_*` (and the CLI-only `SUPABASE_URL`/`SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` pair), `CRON_SECRET=test-cron-secret`, `HASH_SECRET=test-hash-secret-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef` (32+ chars), `MODRINTH_USER=OddSense`, `MODRINTH_USER_AGENT="odsens.com/test (localhost)"` (no email), `YOUTUBE_CHANNEL_ID=UCseedchannel000000000000`, dummy `YOUTUBE_API_KEY=test`, `CURSEFORGE_API_KEY=test`, `RESEND_API_KEY=re_test`, `NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL=allay@odsens.com`, `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=` (empty), `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=http://localhost:3000`, `E2E=1` (enables `/__test/throw` for T-E2E-15 — ADR-0002 #74; also exported by the CI-5 `pnpm start` env), plus the test-only `*_API_BASE` overrides (`_registry.md` Env; ADR-0002 #73) pointing at the fixture server — must contain **no** real key |

### 1.3 Helpers (contracts)
| Helper | Signature (TS) | Behaviour |
|---|---|---|
| `asRole` | `asRole(role: 'anon'\|'user'\|'banned'\|'mod'\|'admin'\|'service'): SupabaseClient` | `anon` = anon key, no session · `user/banned/mod/admin` = anon key + JWT for the matching seed user (§3, `SEED-3`) obtained via `auth.admin.generateLink`/`signInWithPassword` on the local stack · `service` = service-role key (bypasses RLS; used only to arrange state and to prove "service can") |
| `asUser` | `asUser(profileId: string): SupabaseClient` | same as above for an arbitrary factory-created user (second ordinary user, null-handle user) |
| `expectPolicy` | `expectPolicy({ table, op: 'select'\|'insert'\|'update'\|'delete', role, allowed: boolean, row?, patch?, filter?, expectRows? })` | runs the op through `asRole(role)`; `allowed:false` asserts a PostgREST 401/403 **or** zero rows affected (RLS silently filters selects/updates) — the assertion must distinguish "0 rows because denied" from "0 rows because none exist" by first proving the row exists via `service` |
| `callAction` | `callAction(action, input, { role, headers? })` | invokes the Server Action module function directly with a mocked `lib/supabase/server.ts` session for that role; returns the action's `ActionResult<T>` (04 SC-03 / ADR-0002 C14, types in `lib/actions/result.ts`: `{ok:true, data}` \| `{ok:false, error:{code: ActionErrorCode, message, field?, issues?}}`); never goes through HTTP |
| `spies` | `spyRevalidateTag(): { calls: string[] }` · `spyRevalidatePath()` · `spyFetch(fixtureMap)` · `spyLog(): { lines: object[] }` | `next/cache` `revalidateTag`/`revalidatePath` are `vi.mock`ed in every `db` test; assertions on tag names are literal (`projects`, `project:<slug>`, `videos`, `skins`, `art`, `mentions`, `settings`); `spyLog` captures `lib/log.ts` output lines |
| `factories` | `makeProject({source, status, ...})`, `makeVersion`, `makeFile`, `makeComment`, `makeUser({role, banned, handle})`, `makeMention`, `makeVideo`, `makeSkin`, `makeArt`, `makeSyncRun` | insert via `service`; return ids; every factory-created row is tagged (`created_by`/slug prefix `t_`) and removed by `afterEach` cleanup |
| `time` | `freezeAt(iso)`, `advance(ms)` | `vi.useFakeTimers` for the app clock; DB `now()` is not faked — tests that need DB time (15-min edit window, backoff, staleness) set `created_at`/`updated_at`/`finished_at` via `service` instead |
| `mockFetch` | `mockFetch(routes: Record<string, Response \| ((req)=>Response)>)` | adapters take `fetch` by injection (`lib/adapters/*` export `create<Adapter>({ fetch, env })`, 04 SC-25); unit tests never hit the network |
| `storage` | `uploadFixture(bucket, path, fixtureFile)` · `putSigned(signedUrl, token, fixtureFile)` | used by e2e/db global setup to place `tests/fixtures/files/*` and `tests/fixtures/images/*` behind the seed rows; `putSigned` performs the browser step of the two-phase upload (04 §1.4.5) in T-ACT tests |
| `loginAs` | `loginAs(page, role)` (Playwright) | sets the Supabase auth cookies for a seed user by signing in with the local password (`SEED-3`) through the app's `/auth/callback`-equivalent cookie helper; local/CI only |
| `axe` | `expectNoSeriousA11y(page)` | runs axe with tags `wcag2a, wcag2aa`; fails on any violation with impact `serious` or `critical` |
| `screenshots` | `shoot(page, name)` | full-page PNG to `test-results/screenshots/<name>@<viewport.width>.png` |

### 1.4 Roles under test
| Role | Meaning | Seed identity (§3) |
|---|---|---|
| `anon` | no session | — |
| `user` | signed in, handle set, `role='user'`, `is_banned=false`, `comment_count>0` | `seed_user` |
| `user0` (factory) | as `user` but `comment_count=0` (first-time commenter) | `seed_user2` |
| `banned` | signed in, `is_banned=true` | `seed_banned` |
| `mod` | `role='moderator'` | `seed_mod` |
| `admin` | `role='admin'` | `oddsense` |
| `nohandle` | signed in, `handle IS NULL` (onboarding incomplete) | `seed_newbie` |
| `service` | service-role key; RLS bypass; server-only | — |

### 1.5 Harness rules
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| H-1 | `db` project: `globalSetup` runs `supabase db reset` (applies `supabase/migrations/*` + `supabase/seed.sql`) **once per run**; each test file cleans up rows it created in `afterEach` (factories track ids); seed rows are read-only for tests except in tests explicitly marked `mutatesSeed` which restore state in `afterAll`. |
| H-2 | `db` tests run with `pool: 'forks'`, `fileParallelism: false` (one DB, no cross-file races). `unit` tests run fully parallel. |
| H-3 | Every table, view and bucket in the registry Table registry (incl. `rate_limit_hits`, views `comments_public` and `site_settings_public` — ADR-0002 C6/#71) has a file `tests/db/rls/<name>.test.ts`; a table without one fails `T-RLS-123` (meta test) — no schema PR merges without its RLS file. |
| H-4 | Every action in the Server contract registry (incl. `deleteAccount`, `setUserRole`, `renameUserHandle`, `updateVideo`) has `tests/db/actions/<action>.test.ts`; every route handler `tests/db/routes/<slug>.test.ts`; every job `tests/db/jobs/<job>.test.ts`. |
| H-5 | Adapters are tested **only** against `tests/fixtures/`; a test that opens a socket to a non-localhost host fails (`unit` project sets `server.deps` + a `fetch` guard that throws on non-`127.0.0.1` URLs). |
| H-6 | Server Actions under test are imported from `lib/actions/*.ts`; tests never re-implement the action's SQL. Route handlers are invoked as `GET(new Request(url, {headers}))` / `POST(...)` on the exported handler. |
| H-7 | Playwright `smoke` = chromium at **1280×800** and **390×844** (two `projects` entries: `smoke-desktop`, `smoke-phone`, both `use: { colorScheme: 'dark' }`); `e2e` and `admin` projects run at 1280 only; `admin` is `fullyParallel: false`. |
| H-8 | Every `smoke` spec ends with `expectNoSeriousA11y(page)` and `shoot(page, <route-slug>)`; screenshots are the input to `design-fidelity`/`design-fidelity-reviewer`. |
| H-9 | E2E test users sign in through `loginAs` (local password auth on the local stack). Production Auth stays Google-only: `loginAs` refuses to run unless `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL` host is `127.0.0.1`/`localhost`. |
| H-10 | E2E never reaches external hosts: Playwright `context.route('**/*', ...)` aborts any request whose host is not `localhost`/`127.0.0.1`, **except** the Google sign-in start (`T-E2E-16`) which is asserted by URL and then aborted before navigation completes. |
| H-11 | No `test.only` in committed code (ESLint `no-only-tests` rule; CI fails). |
| H-12 | Test names embed their ID: `it('T-RLS-67 comments insert own …')`; CI greps that every ID listed in §8 for the merged slices appears at least once in `tests/**` (`scripts/check-test-ids.mjs`, part of `pnpm lint`). |
| H-13 | **IDs.** This doc owns every `T-*` number; a number is never reused or renumbered after freeze; new cases get the next free number in their layer (appended, never inserted). Every `error.code` asserted in §7 is a member of the 04 §7 `ActionErrorCode` union; every action/job/adapter/RPC/table/path/tag name is the registry spelling (ADR-0002 C16). |

## 2. Fixture recording policy
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| F-1 | Fixtures are real upstream responses recorded **once** by hand with `scripts/record-fixture.mjs <adapter> <name> <url>` (writes `tests/fixtures/<adapter>/<name>.json` + `<name>.meta.json` = `{url, recorded_at, scrubbed: true}`), never at test time. |
| F-2 | Scrub before commit: remove/replace any email, real personal name (other than public creator/channel names, which are allowed — they are public brand handles), IP, auth token, API key, `Set-Cookie`, request ids. Modrinth `team`/`members` arrays are truncated to `user.username` only. YouTube fixtures keep channel titles/handles (public) but drop `contentOwnerDetails`. Fixture PRs list what was scrubbed. |
| F-3 | No fixture may contain a string matching `/[A-Z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Z0-9.-]+\.[A-Z]{2,}/i` except `allay@odsens.com` and `*@localhost.test`; `pnpm lint` runs `scripts/check-fixtures.mjs` enforcing this and F-4. |
| F-4 | Fixture files ≤ 200 KB each; binary fixtures (`tests/fixtures/files/*.zip|.jar|.exe`, `tests/fixtures/images/*.png|.jpg|.webp|.svg`) ≤ 100 KB each and hand-made: `files/pack.zip` (1-file zip), `files/png-as.jar` (PNG bytes, `.jar` name), `files/bad.exe`, `images/icon-256.png`, `images/gallery-640.png`, `images/thumb-1280x720.png`, `images/avatar-600.png`, `images/skin-64.png`, `images/skin-64x32.png`, `images/skin-128.png`, `images/tiny.jpg` (32×32, below the 64×64 avatar minimum), `images/tiny.webp` (1×1), `images/bad.svg`, `images/bad.gif`. Oversize cases are stubbed via declared `size_bytes` (two-phase `begin`) — no 100 MB fixture is committed. |
| F-5 | Required fixture set for v1 (names = 04 §4 "Fixtures" column, extended): `modrinth/user-projects.json` (the 18-project list), `modrinth/project-mod.json`, `modrinth/project-datapack.json` (`project_type=mod`, loaders `["datapack"]`), `modrinth/project-plugin.json` (`mod` + `paper`), `modrinth/project-resourcepack.json`, `modrinth/project-mixed-loaders.json` (`mod` + `["fabric","datapack"]`), `modrinth/project-shader.json` (unsupported type), `modrinth/versions.json` (≥2 versions, one with 2 files, one `beta`), `modrinth/versions-empty.json`, `modrinth/error-429.json`; `curseforge/mod.json` (`data.id` 900001), `curseforge/search.json`, `curseforge/error-403.json`, `curseforge/error-404.json`; `youtube/rss.xml`, `youtube/rss-malformed.xml`, `youtube/videos-list.json` (≥1 short by duration, ≥1 with `#shorts` in title, ≥1 long, ≥1 missing `statistics`), `youtube/playlist-items.json`, `youtube/oembed.json`, `youtube/videos-mentions.json`, `youtube/channels.json`; `oembed/og-page.html`, `oembed/no-og.html`, `oembed/tiktok.html`; `discord/webhook-ok.json`, `discord/429.json`; `resend/send-ok.json`, `resend/422.json`. |
| F-6 | Fixtures are refreshed only when an adapter changes or an upstream schema change breaks the app; a refresh PR re-runs the scrub check and updates `recorded_at`. Never edit fixture values by hand to make a test pass. |
| F-7 | Recording a fixture that would contain PII, or from an authenticated endpoint, is a **stop-and-ask** (test-engineer skill). |
| F-8 | `scripts/check-fixtures.mjs` also verifies that every `{hash}` literal in `supabase/seed.sql` (SEED-4/8/13) equals the first 16 hex chars of sha256 of the named fixture bytes (04 SC-21 `{hash}` rule). |

## 3. Seed data — `supabase/seed.sql`
Applied by `supabase db reset` (config: `[db.seed] sql_paths = ["./seed.sql"]`). Idempotent (`on conflict do nothing`/`do update`), local/preview only, never run against production. Fixed UUIDs so tests can reference rows by constant (`tests/helpers/seedIds.ts` mirrors them). UUID scheme `00000000-0000-4000-8000-00000000<gg><nn>` (last block = 12 hex: 8 zeros + `gg` + `nn`, e.g. `…0101` = `00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101` — matches `tests/helpers/seedIds.ts`; typo fixed 2026-08-17, S0; no rule change): `00`=users, `01`=projects, `02`=comments, `03`=mentions, `04`=versions, `05`=files, `06`=skins, `07`=art. Storage paths follow 04 SC-21 (ids, never slugs).

| # | Rows | Exact contents |
|---|---|---|
| SEED-1 | `site_settings` 1 row | `id=1, moderation_mode='auto', admin_notify_emails='{}', discord_webhook_url=NULL, kofi_page='oddsense', comments_closed_default=false, announcement_md=NULL, owner_profile_id='…0001'` (CREATOR tag — `_registry.md` Table registry / ADR-0002 #55) — the `id=1` row itself is created by migration `20260820120500_site_settings_default_row.sql` (column defaults; production and the persistent `staging` branch never run `seed.sql`); `seed.sql`'s upsert sets `kofi_page` / `owner_profile_id` locally, so the contents above are unchanged (ADR-0015) |
| SEED-2 | `notification_matrix` **16 rows** (8 kinds × `email`,`discord`; PK `(kind, channel)`) | exactly the default matrix in `docs/notifications.md`: `comment.new` email ON discord ON · `comment.held` ON/ON · `comment.reported` ON/ON · `sync.failed` ON/OFF · `sync.stale` ON/OFF · `mention.suggested` OFF/ON · `order.new` ON/ON · `tip.new` OFF/ON |
| SEED-3 | `auth.users` 6 rows + `profiles` (via trigger, then updated) | ids `…0001..0006`; emails `seed-<role>@localhost.test`; local password `seed-password` (local only). Profiles: `…0001` handle `oddsense` role `admin` comment_count 1 · `…0002` `seed_mod` moderator · `…0003` `seed_user` user comment_count 2 · `…0004` `seed_user2` user comment_count 0 · `…0005` `seed_banned` user is_banned true banned_reason `'seed'` comment_count 1 · `…0006` handle NULL (onboarding incomplete). `handle_changed_at NULL`, no `avatar_path` on any (avatars are uploaded by tests). |
| SEED-4 | `projects` 3 rows | `…0101` source `modrinth`, slug `metal-pipe-mace`, project_type `resourcepack`, external_id from `modrinth/user-projects.json`, status published, downloads_modrinth 2531, downloads_curseforge 0, gallery 2 items (CDN urls), loaders `{minecraft}`, game_versions `{1.21,1.21.1}` · `…0102` source `modrinth`, slug `pixel-chameleon`, project_type `mod`, loaders `{fabric}`, downloads_modrinth 1568, downloads_curseforge 120 · `…0103` source `odsens`, slug `seed-exclusive-pack`, project_type `datapack`, status published, `icon_url='project-media/…0103/icon/<hash16 of images/icon-256.png>.png'`, downloads_direct 7, body_md with an h2, list, link and a `<script>` tag (for sanitizer e2e) |

| SEED-11 | `videos` 3 (beyond the minimum, needed by `/videos`) | `seedvid0001` long (600 s), `seedvid0002` long, `seedvid0003` short (45 s, `is_short true`); one with `hidden true` (`seedvid0002`) |
| SEED-12 | `sync_runs` 3 · `stats_daily` 6 · `notification_events` 0 · `notification_recipients` 0 · `project_downloads` 0 · `rate_limit_hits` 0 | one `ok=true` run per source (`modrinth`, `curseforge`, `youtube`) finished 30 min ago (so 04 J-F edge fires on the first failing test run); `stats_daily` = `downloads` per source (site rows, sentinel `entity_id`) for two days |
| SEED-13 | Storage objects | `seed.sql` does **not** upload bytes; e2e/db `globalSetup` calls `uploadFixture` for: `project-files/…0103/…0401/seed-exclusive-pack-1.0.0.zip` ← `files/pack.zip`; `project-media/…0103/icon/<hash16>.png` ← `images/icon-256.png`; `skins/…0601/texture.png`, `skins/…0602/texture.png` ← `images/skin-64.png`; `skins/…0601/bust.png` ← `images/thumb-1280x720.png` (any PNG); `art/…0701/<hash16>.png` ← `images/icon-256.png`; `art/…0702/<hash16>.png` ← `images/thumb-1280x720.png`. |
| SEED-14 | Guard | `seed.sql` first line is the comment `-- LOCAL/PREVIEW ONLY — never run against production (05 SEED-14)`; the file is referenced **only** by `supabase/config.toml` `[db.seed]` — `grep -rn "seed.sql" scripts .github package.json | grep -v scripts/check-fixtures.mjs` → no match (`check-fixtures.mjs` only reads it to verify hashes — F-8; check-wording fix 2026-08-17, S0, not a rule change); `supabase-reviewer` checks both. |

## 4. CI
Workflow: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, triggers `pull_request` + `push` to `main`; `concurrency: {group: ci-${{ github.ref }}, cancel-in-progress: true}`; Node from `.nvmrc`; pnpm via `corepack`; cache pnpm store.

| Job | Steps | Timeout | Required for merge |
|---|---|---|---|
| CI-1 `lint` | `pnpm lint` (= eslint + prettier check + `tsc --noEmit` + `scripts/contrast.mjs` + `scripts/check-fixtures.mjs` + `scripts/check-test-ids.mjs` + `scripts/check-client-islands.mjs` (01 INV-94)) | 10 min | yes |
| CI-2 `unit` | `pnpm test:unit --coverage` → uploads `coverage/` artifact | 10 min | yes |
| CI-3 `db` | `supabase/setup-cli@v1` → `supabase start` → `supabase db reset` → `pnpm test:db --coverage`; on failure uploads `supabase status` + container logs | 15 min | yes |
| CI-4 `build` | `pnpm build` with `.env.test`; then `scripts/check-bundle-secrets.mjs` greps `.next/static/**` for `SERVICE_ROLE`, `sb_secret`, `CURSEFORGE_API_KEY`, `YOUTUBE_API_KEY`, `RESEND_API_KEY`, `DISCORD_WEBHOOK`, `KOFI_`, `CRON_SECRET`, `GOOGLE_OAUTH`, `HASH_SECRET` (01 INV-29 list ∪ these) → fail if found (one ignored match: the supabase-js key-format literal `sb_secret_"` — ADR-0007); uploads the `.next` route table as artifact **`build-output.txt`** (ADR-0002 A13; `frontend-reviewer` diffs a PR's route table against `main`'s latest `build-output.txt` artifact — 01 INV-10) | 15 min | yes |
| CI-5 `e2e` | needs `build`; `supabase start` + `db reset` + `globalSetup` storage upload + fixture server on :4010 (ADR-0002 #73); `E2E=1 pnpm start &` (`.env.test` also carries `E2E=1`; enables `/__test/throw`, T-E2E-15); `pnpm exec playwright install --with-deps chromium`; `pnpm test:e2e`; uploads `test-results/` (traces on retry, screenshots always) | 20 min | yes |
| CI-6 `email` | `pnpm test:unit -t "T-UNIT-3"` is inside CI-2; no separate job | — | — |
| CI-7 `preview` (Vercel) | Vercel GitHub integration builds the preview; `deploy-checker` is run by the human/skill, not by CI | — | not a CI check |

Rules
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| CI-8 | Branch protection on `main`: required checks = `lint`, `unit`, `db`, `build`, `e2e`; linear history; no force-push. |
| CI-9 | CI has **no** repository secrets for v1 (everything runs against the local stack with `.env.test`); a job that needs a real key is out of scope for CI and belongs to `deploy-checker`. |
| CI-10 | Matrix: `ubuntu-latest` × Node `.nvmrc` × Chromium only. No OS/browser matrix in v1. |
| CI-11 | Playwright `retries: process.env.CI ? 1 : 0`; Vitest `retry: 0` everywhere. |
| CI-12 | Coverage thresholds (§6) are enforced in CI-2/CI-3 via `vitest --coverage.thresholds`; a threshold failure fails the job. |
| CI-13 | `supabase/config.toml` `[storage] file_size_limit` must be `100MiB` before S1.3 merges (ADR-0002 #31 / 01 INV-52); CI-3 fails `T-UNIT-18` otherwise. |

## 5. Flakiness policy
| # | Rule |
|---|---|
| FLK-1 | A test that fails then passes on retry in CI is logged by the Playwright reporter (`flaky` status); two flaky occurrences on `main` in 14 days → an issue titled `flaky: <T-ID>` and the test is tagged `@flaky`. |
| FLK-2 | `@flaky` tests still run and still block; they may be moved to `retries: 2` for **max 7 days** by a PR that links the issue. Skipping (`test.skip`/`it.skip`) or deleting a failing test is a stop-and-ask (test-engineer skill) and needs the issue link + date in the skip reason. |
| FLK-3 | Forbidden: `page.waitForTimeout`, `setTimeout` sleeps in tests, order-dependent tests, shared mutable seed rows without `mutatesSeed` + restore, real clocks for time-window logic (use `time.freezeAt` or set `created_at` via `service`). |
| FLK-4 | E2E waits use locators/`expect.poll` with the default 5 s expect timeout, 30 s test timeout; ISR is bypassed in e2e by calling the app's revalidate through the action under test (never by sleeping for `revalidate`). |
| FLK-5 | Unique names per test (`t_<testId>_<random>` slugs/handles) so parallel unit files and re-runs never collide. |

## 7. Test catalog

### 7.1 T-RLS — row-level security matrix
Files: `tests/db/rls/<table>.test.ts`. Each row below expands to one case per role column; the case ID is `T-RLS-<n>-<role>` (roles: `anon`, `user`, `banned`, `mod`, `admin`; extra columns `svc` where the service role is the intended writer). Cell values: **A** = allowed (row visible / write succeeds), **D** = denied (error or 0 rows), **own** = only own row(s), **pub** = only published/visible rows, **—** = not applicable. Expectations follow `docs/data-model.md` §4 literally; cells not stated there are marked ⓘ = the deny-by-default reading of data-model §4 ("only own row / admin") for a case data-model does not spell out; no ⓘ cell contradicts a stated data-model row. Rows for `project_downloads`, `notification_recipients`, `notification_matrix`, `rate_limit_hits` are as ADR-0002 #75 (data-model §4 carries them). Curation/mention RLS stays **admin** (ADR-0002 C7 — moderator actions on those tables do not exist; former OPEN-18 closed). Admin/moderator *actions* run through the service-role client after `requireRole` (04 SC-06), so RLS cells for `mod`/`admin` describe **direct** table access with the anon key + session only.

### 7.2 T-ACT — Server Actions, route handlers, jobs
Files: `tests/db/actions/<action>.test.ts`, `tests/db/routes/<slug>.test.ts`, `tests/db/jobs/<job>.test.ts`. Every action gets (a) an **auth matrix** row, (b) **validation** rows, (c) **side-effect** rows. Auth results: A = `{ok:true}`, D = `{ok:false, error:{code}}` where the code named is a member of 04 §7 (H-13); where no code is named the default is `forbidden` for role failures and `validation` for schema failures. Rate-limit numbers are 04 §5.5 verbatim. Every action must also satisfy `T-ACT-0`.

| ID | applies to | expectation |
|---|---|---|
| T-ACT-0 | every action | (1) returns `ActionResult<T>` per 04 SC-03 / ADR-0002 C14 (`lib/actions/result.ts`) — `{ok:true, data}` or `{ok:false, error:{code: ActionErrorCode, message, field?, issues?}}` — and never throws to the caller (a thrown DB error → `{ok:false, error:{code:'internal'}}` + one `log.error` line with `id`); (2) rejects input that fails its zod schema (`<actionName>Input` exported from the action file's sibling `lib/actions/<area>.schema.ts` — ADR-0013 addendum; 04 SC-02) with `error.code='validation'` and plain-language `issues[]` before any DB call; (3) re-checks role server-side even when RLS would not stop it: the test calls every `requireRole` action through `callAction` with role `user` **while `lib/supabase/admin.ts` is mocked to succeed** and still expects `forbidden`; (4) every `error.code` asserted anywhere in §7.2 ∈ 04 §7 union (meta test greps this doc's IDs' test files) |

### 7.3 T-ADP — adapters vs fixtures
Files: `tests/unit/adapters/<adapter>.test.ts`. Adapters are pure over an injected `fetch` (`create<Adapter>({fetch, env})`, 04 SC-25); function names are the 04 §4 adapter table / `_registry.md` Adapters export list verbatim; every test uses `mockFetch` + `tests/fixtures/`. Common behaviour first, then per adapter.

| ID | adapter | expectation |
|---|---|---|
| T-ADP-1 | all (`lib/adapters/http.ts` `fetchJson`, 04 SC-09/SC-10) | every request has a 10 s timeout (`AbortSignal.timeout(10000)` observed by the mock); on 429 / 5xx / network error it retries with backoff 1 s → 2 s → 4 s (fake timers), honouring `Retry-After` / `X-Ratelimit-Reset` when larger (capped 30 s), **max 3 retries**, then throws `AdapterError {status, code, body ≤ 300}`; 4xx other than 429 is not retried; every request carries `User-Agent` = `env.MODRINTH_USER_AGENT`; the error message and any log line never contain `key=`/`x-api-key`/`Authorization` values |
| T-ADP-2 | `modrinth` | `mapProjectType(project_type, loaders)` (04 §5.2 P1–P5, `PLUGIN_LOADERS = {paper, spigot, bukkit, purpur, folia, velocity, bungeecord, waterfall, sponge}`, `MOD_LOADERS = {fabric, forge, neoforge, quilt, liteloader, rift, modloader}`): P1 (`resourcepack`, any) → `resourcepack` · P2 (`mod`,[`datapack`]) → `datapack` · P3 (`mod`,[`paper`]) / each other plugin loader alone / [`paper`,`velocity`] → `plugin` · P4 (`mod`,[`fabric`]) / (`mod`,[`fabric`,`datapack`]) / (`mod`,[`paper`,`fabric`]) / (`mod`,[]) → `mod` · P5 (`shader`\|`modpack`\|other, any) → `null` (skip) · loader match is case-insensitive |
